output.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM marts.fct_orders WHERE sales_rep_id = 3 AND order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-01-01';
output.explanation: This counts all orders in marts.fct_orders assigned to sales_rep_id 3 with an order_date in calendar year 2025 (fiscal year equals calendar year). No status filter is applied, so cancelled, returned, open and completed orders are all included, as the question asks for any status.
